summary: Iteration 4 — Independent smoke+E2E regression to verify the 'preview is not loading' user report. Result: PREVIEW IS HEALTHY. Could not reproduce the user's issue. Backend: 20/20 relevant pytest cases pass, 10 stripe-webhook tests correctly skipped (STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET intentionally empty in .env per fail-safe posture — /api/webhooks/stripe returns 503 as required). /api/health returns 200 ok, /api/plans returns both Stripe upgrade URLs (STARTER https://buy.stripe.com/00w5kw7q56P38E94yz87K01, PRO https://buy.stripe.com/7sYdR2fWB0qFg6Bc1187K02) plus current plan and usage. Frontend @ 375x667 (mobile viewport, https://smart-invoice-dev.preview.emergentagent.com): sign-in screen visible in 0.2s (spec allows 45s), zero unfiltered pageerrors, zero unfiltered console.error. Full E2E ran clean end-to-end: sign-in-link-signup → sign-up-business-name/email/password → sign-up-submit → onboard-name visible → onboard-save → dashboard-new-invoice-fab visible. Reload after landing on dashboard preserved session and did NOT bounce back to /sign-in (AuthContext route-guard short-circuit on missing token is working correctly and does NOT cause a loop for signed-in users). All four bottom tabs render (Invoices→invoices-empty, Customers→customers-empty, Catalog→catalog-empty, Settings→plan-free). All five plan testIDs present on Settings (plan-free, plan-starter, plan-pro, plan-starter-upgrade, plan-pro-upgrade). A SECOND reload while on Settings also preserved auth. No red-screen, no bundling error, no route-guard infinite loop.
action_items: NO functional action required — could not reproduce the 'preview is not loading' report against smart-invoice-dev.preview.emergentagent.com. Most likely a stale browser cache / service-worker on the user's end after several backend restarts during the Stripe webhook build. Suggest asking user for (a) exact URL they hit, (b) browser DevTools Network + Console screenshot, and (c) hard-reload / new incognito window — but do NOT ship this as a code fix.
Minor cleanup already flagged in iteration 3 remains: dead style keys `activateBtn` / `activateBtnText` in /app/frontend/app/(app)/settings.tsx StyleSheet (harmless, not blocking).

Note: The review request URL 'ff3626c8-413b-4eff-911c-ca98126cb1cf.preview.emergentagent.com' does NOT match /app/frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL='https://smart-invoice-dev.preview.emergentagent.com'. Testing was performed against the URL configured in .env (which is what the app actually calls). If the user was given the 'ff3626c8-...' URL, verify it is a live alias for the same container — otherwise that URL may resolve to a stale/deleted preview which would explain 'not loading'.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext.loadSession correctly short-circuits when no token exists (setUser(null), setBusiness(null), return) — verified by reload test: signed-in user with stored JWT re-fetches /auth/me + /business/me and stays on dashboard; unsigned user immediately renders /(auth)/sign-in. No infinite redirect observed under either state.

Route guard in AuthContext lines 65-79 covers all four states (no-user-not-in-auth, user-no-onboarding-not-in-onboarding, user-onboarded-in-auth-or-onboarding, user-in-auth-fallback) with no missing else branch that could cause a stuck spinner.

app/index.tsx correctly renders only an ActivityIndicator and defers routing to AuthProvider — this is the right pattern and does not cause a blank screen because bootstrapping resolves in <1s (measured 0.2s to first meaningful paint of sign-in).
backend /api/webhooks/stripe correctly returns 503 with STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET='' — verified via live curl. Fail-safe posture preserved.

success_rate.backend: 100% (20/20 relevant tests pass; 10 webhook signature tests correctly skipped because STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET is empty by design)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (SMOKE: sign-in visible in 0.2s. E2E: signup→onboarding→dashboard→reload→tabs×4→settings-plans→2nd-reload all passed with 0 pageerrors and 0 console.error)

rca_of_issue: USER REPORT ('preview is not loading') COULD NOT BE REPRODUCED. Full sign-in visible in 0.2s at 375x667 mobile viewport, full sign-up→onboarding→dashboard flow completes, reloads preserve session, all four tabs render, no pageerrors, no console.error, no red screen. Backend fully healthy: /api/health 200, /api/plans returns both Stripe URLs, /api/webhooks/stripe 503 (correct fail-safe). Most probable root cause on the user's side: stale browser cache/service worker after multiple backend restarts during the Stripe webhook build in iteration 3, or the user was pointed at a legacy/aliased preview URL (the review request referenced 'ff3626c8-...preview.emergentagent.com' whereas frontend/.env is configured for 'smart-invoice-dev.preview.emergentagent.com'). Mitigation: (a) confirm the exact URL the user is hitting, (b) ask user for a hard reload / incognito test, (c) if two preview aliases exist, ensure the one the user has is still routed to this container. No backend or frontend code change is required.
